home.name: Valoree Armstrong
home.title: Full Stack Developer with a People-First Approach
home.valueProposition: Full Stack Developer specializing in user-centered web applications built with React, Node.js, and Spring Boot.
home.achievement1: Built and deployed 10+ full-stack applications using MERN, Spring Boot, and React Native.
home.achievement2: 15+ years improving workflows across healthcare, education, and social services.
home.aboutText1: I am a Full Stack Developer who believes that great software is built with equal parts technical skill, empathy, and clarity. Before transitioning into tech, I spent over 15 years working in education, healthcare, and community-focused roles — experiences that shaped the way I approach problem-solving, communication, and user-centered design.
home.aboutText2: Today, I build web applications with React, Node.js, and Spring Boot, and I am passionate about creating tools that make work easier, more intuitive, and more human. My background gives me a unique advantage — I understand how people think, how teams operate, and how technology can genuinely improve everyday workflows.
home.aboutItem1: Clean, maintainable code and thoughtful user experiences
home.aboutItem3: Energized by learning, teaching, and continuous improvement
home.aboutItem4: Building solutions that serve real people
home.whyHireIntro: Hiring a developer is about more than technical skill — it is about finding someone who communicates clearly, solves problems thoughtfully, and brings reliability to every project. That is the standard I hold myself to.
home.whyHireText: I combine full-stack development skills with 15+ years of real-world experience supporting teams, improving workflows, and helping people understand complex ideas. I am comfortable stepping into ambiguity, asking the right questions, and turning scattered requirements into structured, actionable solutions.
home.whyHireItem1: A strong foundation in MERN and Spring Boot development
home.whyHireItem2: Clear, consistent communication and collaborative problem-solving
home.whyHireItem3: A user-centered mindset shaped by years of service-oriented work
home.whyHireItem4: The ability to mentor, support, and uplift new learners and teammates
home.whyHireItem5: A commitment to clean code, thoughtful design, and continuous improvement
home.whyHireClosing: If you are looking for a developer who blends technical ability with empathy, structure, and a genuine desire to build meaningful solutions — I am ready to contribute.
home.contactCTAText: I am currently open to full-time roles, contract work, and freelance projects.
